notes.title: Game version 1.0.3 update.
notes.content:
[i][b]v1.0.3[/b][/i]

[b]*Bug Fixes[/b]

・Fixed an issue where EthShard were not displayed correctly in the shop screen due to the 1.0.2 update.

[b]*System Adjustments[/b]

・Added a help section.
You can view game rules, terms, and gameplay tips.
It can be accessed from the book icon to the left of the options icon.

[b]*Balance Adjustments[/b]

・When you reach the boss on the 5th floor, you will receive a specific advantage at the start of the next game.
This bonus only applies to the same character and Extend.
For example, if you are defeated by the 5th floor boss in Extend 2 Gladiator, the bonus will be applied the next time you play at Extend 2 as a Gladiator.
You cannot earn a bonus in Extend 1 and activate it in Extend 5.
Note that if you play with a different character or Extend, your "previous play" will be updated.

・Adjusted the card selection method in the shop.
The first two cards will be drawn based on the type specific to the character being played, while the remaining cards will be drawn as usual.

Please report any bugs that may occur due to this update,
and report if the help section is difficult to understand or if there are any mistranslations.

notes.title: Notice regarding the next update.
notes.content:
[b]The following adjustments and additions are currently being made.[/b]

[i][b]We will add a Help section.[/b][/i]
This menu will allow you to check game rules, terminology, and gameplay tips. It will be placed next to the options icon for easy access.

[i][b]We will add a menu to display a list of cards you have acquired and your completion rate.[/b][/i]
*However, since there is no current data on "cards you have acquired," we apologize but only cards obtained after implementation will be added.

[i][b]We will adjust the card draw method in the shop.[/b][/i]
*For example, for Cryomancer, we will ensure that several Eether-type cards appear.

[i][b]If you reach the fifth boss layer but do not clear it, we will provide some advantages at the start of the next game.[/b][/i]
*For example, you can choose to increase certain stats or increase the initial EthShard.

[i][b]We will fix parts of the UI where the user experience is poor, such as volume adjustment.[/b][/i]

The above implementations will be carried out from this weekend to next weekend and will be updated as soon as they are ready.
